5821.title: Unbounded append-only service capture files
5821.rootCauseOneLine: The launcher gives child stdout and stderr an append-only file descriptor, with no live size limit, rotation, or restart retention policy.
5821.proposedFix: Design bounded capture retention with a live descriptor reopen or bounded sink strategy while preserving the existing protection against terminal and parent-stream backpressure.
5821.caveats: Reproduced twice on Linux against the exact launcher helper; the reported Mac file size, warning volume, and historical file count were not independently checked. The full reproduction script and outputs are inline because the reports repository forbids separate scripts and logs. No PR: safe live rotation requires a retention/reopen design decision outside the simple-fix gate.
